features.name: shared routing
features.limitations: Precise versus line steps, actual-change consumption, boundary deferral, axis lock and horizontal trapping exist. Existing tests assert consumed/refused events and nested touch routing. These do not certify every owner.

features.name: VirtualList
features.limitations: Uses common scroll reduction and adds keyboard navigation. Windowing/model tests are separate from physical touch evidence.

features.name: Sidebar
features.limitations: Uses shared geometry, skin and scroll state with clipped translated content and cached rows. Existing precise-scroll fixture is not a physical native-device test.

features.name: Tabs consumption
features.limitations: Wheel/converted touch SCROLL changes offset without cui_consume_event or boundary deferral. Thumb reducer separately consumes keyboard events. Existing scrollbar tests cover drag, keyboard, hidden/style geometry; they do not establish nested SCROLL ownership.

features.name: DataTable consumption
features.limitations: Body/root scroll offsets are changed in bespoke loops without consumption/deferral. Common bars exist, but their presence does not prove these loops chain correctly. Disabled/loading gates and final clamp exist.

features.name: shift wheel
features.limitations: Browser converts shift+vertical delta to horizontal only when deltaX is zero. SDL wheel branch forwards x/y without shift mapping or wheel modifiers. Hosts therefore differ. Upstream lock_scroll_axis is not proof that shift conversion is required by that API.

features.name: visibility modes
features.limitations: Visible/Hidden/AutoHide/Inherited exist. Upstream Always/Scrolling/Hover includes distinct hover-only mode absent here. AUTO_HIDE also wakes on owner hover and holds focused descendants; do not equate it exactly with upstream Scrolling.

features.name: idle scheduling
features.limitations: CUI invalidates continuously through idle and fade; existing tests deliberately assert redraw during idle. Upstream requests animation only while moving and schedules a delayed idle notification. Changing this needs a reusable host-visible wake deadline, not simply removing invalidation.

features.name: skin and motion
features.limitations: Thickness/minimum thumb/radii/track hiding/custom colors/fade/reduced motion exist. No independent active/hover width, thumb-hover entrance or configurable enter/expand choreography. Upstream drag notification throttling is also not represented by the CUI API.

features.name: touch drag lifetime
features.limitations: Core contact routing, explicit drag priority and cancellation are present. Upstream thumb touch drag prevents default/stops propagation. Existing CUI CDP and queued SDL tests are synthetic input evidence; no physical OS/device certification.

first_proposal: Tabs SCROLL actual-change consumption and boundary chaining; no public API changes
